author: agent
statement: Discard the Run 114 one-card release window. The 7/6 controller recovers exactly 62.023 s of admission wait but converts none of it into another delivered unit or earlier terminal service; it increases average WIP by 2.0674 equivalents, increases mean cycle by 4.2481 s, shifts final packaged WIP from lot 07 to lot 08, regresses every current operating case, and breaks facility-interruption on-time service 9 → 8. Retain 6/5 EDD as intentional WIP/service protection. Reopen release control only with a physically distinct coordination mechanism that improves downstream service without adding front-end cards; keep the measured controller wait visible in Analysis.
